problems.title: Fibonacci Number
problems.description_short: Practice recursive calls, base cases, and function call stacks.
problems.learning_note: A classic example of recursion where each number is the sum of the two preceding ones.

problems.title: Two Sum
problems.description_short: Practice key/value lookup using JavaScript Objects or Hash Maps.
problems.learning_note: Use an object/map to store previously seen numbers for O(1) lookup.

problems.title: Reverse String
problems.description_short: Write a function that reverses a string in-place with recursion or two pointers.
problems.learning_note: Great practice for recursion base cases and string array manipulation.

problems.title: Valid Anagram
problems.description_short: Determine if string t is an anagram of s by counting frequency of primitive chars using an object.
problems.learning_note: Demonstrates object hash mapping for character frequency tracking.

problems.title: Contains Duplicate
problems.description_short: Check if any value appears at least twice using an object hash map for fast membership check.
problems.learning_note: Shows the power of key lookup in objects versus linear search.

problems.title: Power of Two
problems.description_short: Determine if an integer is a power of two using recursive division.
problems.learning_note: Focus on primitive number properties and base case reduction.

problems.title: Function Composition
problems.description_short: Given an array of functions, return a composition function.
problems.learning_note: Deepens understanding of function calls, parameters, and return values.

problems.title: Filter Elements from Array
problems.description_short: Implement a custom filter function without using Array.prototype.filter.
problems.learning_note: Practice passing functions as arguments and managing return values.

problems.title: Pow(x, n)
problems.description_short: Calculate x raised to the power n using logarithmic recursion.
problems.learning_note: Divide-and-conquer recursion reducing O(n) to O(log n).

problems.title: First Unique Character in a String
problems.description_short: Find the first non-repeating character using object frequency counting.
problems.learning_note: Combines object property accumulation with string iteration.

problems.title: Palindrome Number
problems.description_short: Determine whether an integer is a palindrome without converting to string.
problems.learning_note: Pure primitive number manipulation and digit extraction.

problems.title: Add Two Integers
problems.description_short: Return the sum of two integer variables.
problems.learning_note: Simple variable storage and return value practice.
